goal: whole-result package, normal cadence, no token budget, no same-day scope reduction

results.name: typed pure catalog

checks.note: catalog+negative+preview suites landed in this source checkpoint; J12 consumes the preview layer

results.capability: Pure deterministic match over project-facts/1 + public ApplicationConfiguration + kind + explicit selection, producing draft/needs_input/unsupported with provenance, configuration revision, facts digest, authorization none and content-addressed revision. The preview layer (CreateWorkFields/toCreateWorkCommand) landed in the same source checkpoint so main/F can consume it immediately.

results.name: read-only facts CLI
results.capability: Explicit authorized root only; allow-listed names; O_NOFOLLOW + fstat; file/size/total budgets; JSON only for package.json; lockfiles hashed as opaque bytes; script names only. Documented exits 0/2/3/4/5 and new-file-only --output.

results.name: usable preview draft

checks.observed: draft + needs_input + draft, create_work command validated by UserCommandSchema

results.capability: draft → CreateWorkFields → create_work command candidate (validated by the public UserCommandSchema), plus assertDraftCurrent/previewInputs refusing a draft whose configuration revision or facts digest changed.
notReached: main has not wired an HTTP/App route; F has not rendered the form. Delivered is the typed consumer and runnable example, not a UI.

results.name: multi-project tool
results.capability: Two independently authorized roots (pnpm single package, npm monorepo) through the actual CLI: isolated drafts, different profile/check/scope per project, monorepo root requires explicit paths, byte-identical repeat observation, refused cross-config reuse.

results.name: docs and final handoff
results.capability: Support matrix, facts contract, CLI contract and exit codes, result code table, failure matrix, cost/privacy budgets, compatibility and the concrete main/F wiring (including the exact pnpm-lock importer main must add).

stages.title: understand existing checks and draft boundaries
stages.capability: Reused ApplicationConfiguration (projects/profiles/checks), ScopeSchema, CriterionSchema/RequiredCriteriaSchema, CheckRegistry public views, ProjectRegistrationInputSchema check enum, and the create_work command shape. No new authority: no runner, verifier, installer, ledger or execution state.
stages.note: The repository has no WorkDraft type; the existing confirmation input is the create_work user command, which preview.ts targets instead of inventing a parallel draft contract.

stages.title: stable typed recipe output
stages.capability: Closed statuses and closed issue-code vocabulary; provenance carries catalog/configuration/facts/selection/input digests; authorization is the literal 'none'; no executable/argv/command/token field exists in the schema.

stages.title: deterministic catalog
stages.capability: Three practical kinds; identical input yields identical bytes and revision; scope only narrows; criteria/profile come from configuration; missing capabilities become needs_input/unsupported, never a fixture or another agent.

stages.title: first complete result: typed pure catalog
stages.capability: 41 package tests (catalog, negative, preview, compatibility), strict typecheck and build; examples are data and carry no command.

stages.title: injectable public project facts
stages.capability: Facts accept injection with provenance/observedAt/scope/support flags/missing; stale and future observations become needs_input facts_stale; gaps are never filled by guessing paths or running version commands.

stages.title: explicitly authorized metadata read
stages.capability: Allow-listed names under one absolute authorized root; O_NOFOLLOW+fstat; symlink/non-regular/oversize/out-of-root refused; no home/env/.npmrc/credential/script body read; observation is read-only (mtime/size/mode asserted unchanged).

stages.title: package metadata and unknown capabilities
stages.capability: Only name/packageManager/engines/workspace declaration/script names/lockfile names+digests; script values never read; yarn/bun unsupported; unknown manager needs_input; Node is never assumed for a non-Node root.

stages.title: second complete result: read-only facts CLI
stages.capability: Real CLI with --help, injected facts or authorized root, documented exits, stdout JSON plus stderr notes, new-file-only output, no model/agent/install and no project write.

stages.title: current config and scope matching
stages.capability: Scope may only narrow (pathWithin boundary aware), exclusions only grow, externalActions always empty; discussion-only/unavailable/blocked projects are explained; a draft from an older configuration revision or older facts is refused by assertDraftCurrent.

stages.title: registered check reference and policy reuse
stages.capability: Only criteria already present in defaultCriteria and checkDefinitionRef already listed in configuration.checks; a selection without a required registered machine check becomes needs_input criteria_machine_required; an unregistered ref would be unsupported (defensive).

stages.title: preview draft main/F can consume
stages.capability: Stable CreateWorkFields plus toCreateWorkCommand (public schema validated); commandId/conversationId/actor/token stay with the application.
notReached: no App/transport/UI change and no new endpoint: J owns none of those paths

stages.title: third complete result: usable preview draft
stages.capability: catalog → facts → config/policy → confirmable fields chain verified in-process; the final action remains the original user confirmation.
notReached: main/F visual/HTTP integration is not implemented in this worktree

stages.title: real multi-project and task kinds
stages.capability: Two authorized roots with different manager (pnpm/npm), layout (single/monorepo), profile/check/scope; drafts are isolated by real IDs; a controlled-fixture configuration yields a fixture profile with no native wording, a native configuration inherits no fixture readiness, and an explicit profile choice is honoured rather than replaced.

stages.title: failure and abnormal input
stages.capability: Single-cause negatives in the library plus boundary refusals (bad JSON, oversize, one-byte-over budget, symlink, directory-as-file, missing, nested-not-read, output exists); refusal messages never echo file contents or secrets; unknown never becomes zero/pass.

stages.title: compatibility, version and scope
stages.capability: Supported configuration/facts/catalog versions stated; unknown configuration version is unsupported with the observed protocol recorded and revision null; catalog changes require a version bump and change the recorded digest.

stages.title: fourth complete result: multi-project reusable tool
stages.capability: 29 tools tests + 41 package tests; CLI and library write no SQL/registry/environment and create no execution state or cost ledger.

stages.title: cost and privacy boundaries
stages.capability: 256 KiB JSON (inclusive; one byte over refused), 4 MiB lockfile, 12 files, 8 MiB total, 60-minute facts freshness (CLI exit 3), 512 script names, schema collection caps; output carries no private material.

stages.title: complete usage and development documentation
stages.capability: Independent developer can reproduce the three recipes, the failure handling and the wiring from committed commands and fixtures; unsupported stacks, unregistered checks and real execution admission are stated explicitly.

stages.title: real consumer and independent acceptance input
stages.capability: Stable source, typed consumer and a runnable example are available for main/F/E; the public create_work schema still validates the produced command.
notReached: E independent product-acceptance assertions were not added or modified (E owns them); no installed/native verdict is claimed

stages.title: fifth complete result and final handoff
stages.capability: This status lists source, commands/exits, provenance and actual capability per stage; explicitly names what is not built.

evidence.note: contracts is a pre-existing workspace dependency; J only built it locally, it did not change it

notReached: main's actual HTTP/App composition of these drafts (main owns root/contracts/HTTP/App)
F's actual form rendering and keyboard/mobile checks
monorepo member enumeration (pnpm-workspace.yaml content is never parsed)
package-manager version probing (no --version execution by design)
